title: Hawaiian Chili Pepper Water

items: 4-8 Hawaiian chili peppers  (substitute: 8 birds eye chilies or 2 Habanero peppers)
2.5 tsp Alaea Red Hawaiian Sea Salt

steps: Mince the garlic, ginger, and chili peppers (seeds included).
Add all ingredients to a pot and bring to a boil then remove from heat.
Transfer to a bottle when cool then refrigerate.
The sauce can be used immediately but will taste best after it has infused for 2-3 days.
